about: Ground truth for the maintainer's own recording, the primary v0.4.1 evidence (docs/V0_4_1_PLAN.md, the v0.4.1 Detection Reliability Audit). Times are video seconds. Every chest and every listed non-chest pop-up was confirmed by looking at the frames; candidates came from scale sweeps with the production, native-size and resampled templates (blurred >= 0.78 or exact >= 0.55 anywhere in x 780-1040, y 150-320), so a pop-up hidden by an overlay for its whole life would be missing. v040 = what v0.4.0 (fa1747d) did with it.
source: maintainer's own PC game, OBS 33.0.1 local recording: 1280x720, 30 fps, H.264 NVENC 4 Mbps CBR; Zero Build squads, English

hud.how: ratios to the reference streamer's normal HUD (Fortnites-NEW-HD), not the Fortnite setting value, which is not yet known
